target_customer: Banks, fintechs and lenders in Southeast Asia that need account aggregation, e-KYC and alternative credit scoring
problem: Southeast Asian financial firms lacked an open finance data layer comparable to Plaid, so each had to build bank connections and data products themselves.
business_model: Product as a service open finance infrastructure for businesses (per press, in contrast to pay per usage rivals)

founders.name: Diego Rojas
founders.background_notes: YC page: software engineer with 16+ years in fintech, BI and distributed systems.

founders.name: Keng Low
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page; role CPO per e27.

founders.name: Edwin Kusuma
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder and COO in the June 2021 TechNode seed article.

competitors.name: Brankas
competitors.what: Open banking and payment APIs for the Philippines and Indonesia
competitors.traction_then: Described by a backer as arguably the market leader

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to many bank APIs and screen scraping paths across several countries plus data products is standard but integration heavy work.

defensibility.rationale: Bank integrations and licences take time to replicate, but rivals Brankas and Brick offered similar connectivity.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought Finantier; DealStreetAsia reported in September 2023 that it was said to have shut down.

market_need_then: Open banking was being introduced in Southeast Asia in 2020 and press at the time described account aggregation and credit scoring needs of fintechs and lenders; no hard spend figures were found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positioned as Plaid for Southeast Asia

brand_strength.rationale: Regional trade press covered the raises, but no brand specific press, community or merch was found.

outcome_analysis: Finantier raised a pre-seed in November 2020 and a seven figure seed in June 2021 from regional and global funds, with a team of about 40 listed by YC. DealStreetAsia reported in September 2023 that it was said to have shut down, but the article text with reasons was not accessible and no post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public.
notes: No company website listed in the dataset and none searched found. Seed amount is described only as seven figures; a Tech in Asia link on the YC page mentions a valuation above 38M but that article was not opened, so no valuation recorded. Shutdown is reported as unconfirmed ('said to have'). Search snippets from CB Insights show other competitors (Brick, Finverse, Ayoconnect) from undated aggregator pages, not listed.
